title: A successful warm Turbopack build emitted stale CSS
steps: Use a CSS loader with Turbopack and complete a successful production build.
Add layout declarations to the global stylesheet, then run another production build.
Compare the emitted CSS with the changed stylesheet, then compare a clean rebuild.
observed: The warm build exited successfully but the emitted CSS retained the previous layout rules.
A clean build emitted the new declarations and the rendered layout then matched the stylesheet.
expected: A successful rebuild should emit the current stylesheet declarations.
comparison: Moving the previous build output aside and performing a clean build picked up the changed CSS.
